senses.gloss:
इडा f. (-डा)
 1. The wife of BUDDHA, daughter of IKSHAKU.
 2. The earth.
3. A cow.
 4. Speed.
 5. A tubular vessel, one of the principal
channels of the vital spirit, that which is on the right side of the
body.
 6. Heaven.
 7. The goddess of speech.
 E. इल् to direct or send,
क affix, and टाप् fem. ल and ड are interchangeable: see इला.
ईड r. 2nd cl. (ईट्टे) also 10th cl. (ईडयति) To praise.

ईडा f. (-डा) Praise.
 E. ईड् to praise, क and टाप affs.

इडाचिका f. (-का) A wasp.
 E. इडा the earth, चर् to go, and ड्वन् aff.

ईडन n. (-नं) Praising.
 E. ईड and ल्युट् aff.
